scenes.prologue: [BOOT · engine ready] the ygg world is loaded (engine {{engine}}), current stage {{stage}}, evolution preference {{mode}} (narration only — resources are never rewritten automatically). This is a two-layer agent meta-workflow: the coordinator dispatches and accepts; each requirement runs plan → gate → develop → accept → gate.
scenes.intake: [WAITING FOR TASK] current stage {{stage}}: submit the task description first. require_all_green = {{gates}}.
scenes.coordinate: [COORDINATING] task "{{title}}": {{description}} | {{count}} requirements ({{open}} open) | {{pending}} pending proposals. In this layer you do exactly three things: dispatch, accept proposals serially, pass the two mandatory gates; analyze / plan / develop of other requirements may run asynchronously in parallel.
scenes.review: [FINAL REVIEW] task "{{title}}": {{count}} requirements ({{done}} done) | require_all_green {{gates}}. Closing is allowed only when every leaf requirement is done with no pending proposal and no unresolved conflict.

endings.done: [ENDING · run closed] task "{{title}}" — {{count}} requirements ({{done}} done), review score {{score}}/5, evolution candidates {{candidates}} (kept/screened). One-line lesson: {{lesson}}

prompts.intake: Cold start: submit the task description, or adjust runtime config first?
prompts.coordinate: Next step: accept a proposal, pass a gate, dispatch, or close into final review?
prompts.review: Final review: how are the gates? Once green, screen evolution candidates against the evolution chapter, register settlement.evolution (it also settles sessions and todo in the same transaction), then review.note records the lesson and archives single-source to close the run.

options.dispatch: requirement.dispatch — dispatch by readiness order ({{count}} candidates, jobs {{jobs}}/{{cap}}, head {{id}})
options.coordinate_submit: coordinate.submit — enter final review once every requirement is closed
options.verify_green: verify.submit all_green=true — gates are green (record evidence, move to review)
options.verify_fail: verify.submit all_green=false — report the failure honestly (sent back to coordinate)
options.settlement_evolution: settlement.evolution — register the evolution review and settle sessions + todo in one transaction (payload "artifact|summary[|c=<kept>/<screened>[|cls=<kind>:<n>,...]][|sessions=<moved>/<remaining>/<destination>][|todo=<remaining>/<verified_by>]")
options.review_note: review.note — record the lesson, archive the evolution registration single-source and close the run (payload "lesson|score")
options.req_list: requirement.list — show the requirement graph / proposals / lanes ({{pending}} pending, {{open}} open)
options.map: map.show — show the two-layer node map (coordinator {{stage}})
options.config: config — config entry (play mode / evolution preference / gates; opens a sub-page)
options.config_close: back — return to the stage menu
options.config_evolution: config.set — evolution preference {{mode}} → {{next}} (narration only, no auto-rewrite)
options.req_resolve_keep: requirement.resolve keep_both — {{ids}} keep both sides and requeue
options.req_resolve_first: requirement.resolve keep_first — {{ids}} keep the first, the other becomes dropped
options.req_resolve_revise: requirement.resolve revise — {{ids}} keep both but flag needs-amend
options.gate_approve: gate.approve — pass the {{kind}} gate on {{id}} ({{gates}} gates left)
options.gate_reject: gate.reject — reject the {{kind}} gate on {{id}} and send it back for rework
options.settlement_sessions: settlement.sessions — register subagent session cleanup (payload "moved|remaining|destination", remaining must be 0)
options.settlement_todo: settlement.todo — register main-session todo cleanup (payload "remaining|verified_by", remaining must be 0)

beats.settlement_evolution_usage: settlement.evolution payload: artifact|summary[|c=<kept>/<screened>[|cls=<kind>:<n>,...]][|sessions=<moved>/<remaining>/<destination>][|todo=<remaining>/<verified_by>]; summary is required after trim and must not contain |; the only optional segments are c=, cls=, sessions= and todo= — ev=, duplicates and unknown segments are refused.

beats.config_opened: [CONFIG MENU] play mode / evolution preference / gates — picking one applies it and stays on this page; pick "back" to return to the stage menu. Note: switching play mode leaves this page (the driver changed, so the sub-page context is stale). Evolution pre-registration does not use the menu: write settings with `config.set review.evolution.artifact|summary|candidates|classes=<value>`; after verify passes the settlement.evolution menu builds the payload and validates it in one place.

beats.handover_goal: [DECISION HANDOVER] play.mode = goal: the main agent reads the full receipt and then dispatches by itself (never the default first option, never a script); acceptance and both gates still take one real action and one validation each, evidence standards unchanged. The closing review must account for the delegated scope.
beats.handover_guide: [DECISION HANDOVER] play.mode = guide: every following step is confirmed by a human (reply with the index); milestone actions still need the menu ticket.
beats.prologue_common: shared by both modes: acceptance and both gates still take one real action and one validation each, never skipped; requirements can be added asynchronously (--requirement / --proposal).
beats.intake_common: write "title|description" and submit; confirm with the index.
beats.coordinate_common: accept proposals first (proposal.accept), then pass gates (gate.approve/reject), then dispatch (requirement.dispatch), finally coordinate.submit.
beats.review_common: once every gate is green, register settlement.evolution first (it settles sessions and todo in the same transaction), then review.note records the lesson and archives single-source to close the run; screen candidates against the evolution chapter first. summary is required after trim; when screened > 0 artifact and cls are required, c=0/0 allows an empty artifact; a declaration only proves what was declared, not the quality of the suggestions.
beats.stage_prompt_missing: (the prompt for this node is missing: check <node>_common in data/scenes.json)
beats.evolution_auto: evolution auto: preference marker only (cap {{cap}}, paths {{paths}}) — no auto-rewrite, no revision requests registered; suggestions still go through the separate settlement.evolution registration.
beats.review_note_usage: review.note accepts only lesson|score; the evolution record must be registered through settlement.evolution first — this action only archives it single-source.
beats.review_note_legacy_evolution: review.note no longer accepts ev= / c= / cls= segments; register with settlement.evolution first, then close with lesson|score.
beats.review_evolution_bad_path: invalid evolution artifact path: must be `artifacts/<file>.md`, no `..` and no whitespace.
beats.review_evolution_bad_candidates: invalid evolution candidate count: `c=<kept>/<screened>`, two non-negative integers with kept <= screened.
beats.review_evolution_bad_classes: invalid evolution candidate classes: `cls=<kind>:<n>,...`, kind must be one of the six classes, counts non-negative and unique.
beats.review_evolution_mismatch: the evolution declaration is not self-consistent: the cls counts must sum to screened, and the kept classes (long_term + unused + redundant) must sum to kept.
beats.review_evolution_need_artifact: with candidates (screened > 0) the first segment of settlement.evolution must be `artifacts/<file>.md` — every screened candidate needs a review record, not only the kept ones.
beats.review_evolution_need_classes: with candidates (screened > 0) you must provide per-class root-cause counts: cls=<kind>:<n>,... (the six classes sum to screened, the kept classes sum to kept).

beats.goal_auth_cleared: [GOAL AUTH CLEARED] a runtime goal run must register it again before closing.

beats.config_goal_auth: goal authorization: {{auth}} (self-declared, only checked when a runtime goal run closes)

beats.settlement_sessions_ok: subagent sessions settled: moved {{moved}} to {{destination}} (moved to the trash — never permanently deleted, main session untouched).
beats.settlement_sessions_usage: settlement.sessions payload "moved|remaining|destination": moved a non-negative integer, remaining exactly 0, destination non-empty (e.g. ~/.pi/agent/sessions-trash/<batch>); all three segments are required.
beats.settlement_sessions_segment_bad: the settlement.evolution sessions= segment must be `<moved>/<remaining>/<destination>`: moved a non-negative integer, remaining exactly 0, destination non-empty (slashes inside the destination are kept).

beats.settlement_todo_ok: main-session todo list cleared: re-checked to 0 items (basis: {{verified_by}}).
beats.settlement_todo_payload: 0|main session todo list re-checked to 0 items (done + historical included)
beats.settlement_todo_usage: settlement.todo payload "remaining|verified_by": exactly two segments, remaining exactly 0, verified_by non-empty and <= 120 chars.
beats.settlement_todo_segment: todo=0/main session todo list re-checked to 0 items (done + historical included)
beats.settlement_todo_segment_bad: the settlement.evolution todo= segment must be `<remaining>/<verified_by>`: remaining exactly 0, verified_by non-empty and <= 120 chars.
beats.settlement_verify_first: record all-green evidence with verify.submit first, then register the three settlement tasks (all of them in the review stage).
